{{Top|leg}}
'''Lony Hertz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who ran [[Lony Hertz's Force Adept Club]], which specialized in finding suitable mentor for [[Force Adept]]s, so that they could learn about [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] from a non-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] perspective. She attended the [[Cularin Trade Show]] to try and find Force Adepts to pair with potential apprentices. She approached the Force Adept [[Grrandash]] about this, but he refused to help her.
